sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收看《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要把300件最珍贵的藏品带去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个美丽的、有50年历史的古董移动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》的我，是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the nomination of President Trump's personal doctor as the next head of Veterans Affairs had come to an abrupt stop.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统的私人医生被提名为退役事务部下一任负责人，这一任命已经戛然而止。

sentences.en: Now, Congress is describing the alarming allegations from unnamed whistleblowers that derailed the doctor's nomination.
sentences.zh: 现在，国会正在披露导致该医生提名受阻的、来自匿名举报人的令人担忧的指控。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月25日，星期三。

sentences.en: This was the week that Dr. Ronnie Jackson, who currently serves at the White House as the president's personal physician,
sentences.zh: 本周，目前在白宫担任总统私人医师的罗尼·杰克逊博士，

sentences.en: he was supposed to come to Capitol Hill to be vetted and interviewed by members of Congress to run one of the largest bureaucracies in the federal government,
sentences.zh: 他原本应该来到国会山，接受国会议员的审查和面试，以掌管联邦政府最大的官僚机构之一——

sentences.en: the Veterans Affairs Department.
sentences.zh: 退伍军人事务部。

sentences.en: Mike Scheer covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 迈克·谢尔为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: This is a fellow, Ronnie Jackson, who hasn't gotten any serious management experience, not somebody who has been in charge of huge numbers of staff,
sentences.zh: 罗尼·杰克逊这家伙没有任何严肃的管理经验，不是那种管过大量员工的人，

sentences.en: not somebody that's been in charge of a large budget.
sentences.zh: 也不是那种掌管过庞大预算的人。

sentences.en: And so there were always going to be questions from Democrats for sure, but also from Republicans as to is this the right person to lead not only one of the biggest agencies,
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人肯定会产生疑问，共和党人也同样会质疑：这是否是领导不仅是最大机构之一、

sentences.en: but one of the most troubled.
sentences.zh: 而且也是问题最多的机构的合适人选？

sentences.en: Well, another VA scandal is brewing this time at the Philadelphia office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，又一场退伍军人事务部的丑闻正在酝酿，这次是在费城办公室。

sentences.en: There is a scathing new report about care problems at Veterans Affairs facilities across the country.
sentences.zh: 有一份关于全国各地退伍军人事务部设施护理问题的新报告，内容极为严厉。

sentences.en: It is no stretch to say the Department of Veterans Affairs has a trust problem.
sentences.zh: 毫不夸张地说，退伍军人事务部存在信任危机。

sentences.en: You know, Veterans Affairs has struggled for years under scandal.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，退伍军人事务部多年来一直在丑闻中挣扎。

sentences.en: And as many as 40 veterans died while they were waiting for medical care at this VA facility.
sentences.zh: 多达40名退伍军人在这个退伍军人事务部医疗机构等待医疗护理时死亡。

sentences.en: In the fallout in the Veterans Affairs scandal, the top official in charge of medical care for our vets is resigning.
sentences.zh: 在退伍军人事务部丑闻的余波中，负责我们退伍军人医疗的最高官员正在辞职。

sentences.en: But also just general kind of mismanagement and a sense that this is an agency that doesn't operate well.
sentences.zh: 但这也包括一般性的管理不善，以及人们觉得这是一个运作不佳的机构。

sentences.en: You can't fix the VA.
sentences.zh: 你无法修复退伍军人事务部。

sentences.en: No amount of money is going to fix the VA.
sentences.zh: 再多的钱也无法修复退伍军人事务部。

sentences.en: And I hate to be so grim.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌表现得这么残酷。

sentences.en: And so, you know, members of Congress, I think,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我认为国会议员们

sentences.en: had the idea that they were going to grill Dr. Jackson on what is it that you bring other than a friendship with the president and an affinity with the president?
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，他们要盘问杰克逊博士：除了与总统的友谊和情投意合之外，你还能带来什么？

sentences.en: What is it that you bring to the job that can address some of these really chronic problems at the VA?
sentences.zh: 你到底能给这份工作带来什么，来解决退伍军人事务部这些真正长期的顽疾？

sentences.en: And how did it come to be that this controversial nomination was made in the first place?
sentences.zh: 这个充满争议的提名最初究竟是怎么出炉的？

sentences.en: What happened to the previous head of the Veterans Affairs Department?
sentences.zh: 退伍军人事务部的前任负责人怎么了？

sentences.en: So the previous head had been an Obama holdover.
sentences.zh: 所以前任负责人是奥巴马时期留任的官员。

sentences.en: He was ousted after a kind of long period of will he or won't he go.
sentences.zh: 在经历了一段关于他到底去留的漫长拉锯期后，他被赶下了台。

sentences.en: And I think there was an expectation that in the wake of that,
sentences.zh: 我认为人们有一种预期，在那之后，

sentences.en: President Trump would turn to somebody with either really deep credentials in the veterans community or somebody who had a lot of experience, for example, in business.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统会转向那些在退伍军人社群中拥有极深资历的人，或者比如在商界拥有丰富经验的人。

sentences.en: That's something that Trump obviously values.
sentences.zh: 这显然是特朗普所看重的东西。

sentences.en: Breaking news from the White House tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚来自白宫的突发新闻。

sentences.en: President Trump late today fired his secretary of Veterans Affairs, David Shulkin.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统今天晚些时候解雇了他的退伍军人事务部部长戴维·舒尔金。

sentences.en: Instead, in an abrupt moment that no one saw coming.
sentences.zh: 相反，在一个没有人预料到的突然时刻，

sentences.en: The big surprise was not Shulkin's ouster, which had been rumored for weeks.
sentences.zh: 最大的惊喜不是舒尔金被罢免——这已经传了好几个星期了——

sentences.en: It was who he's nominating to replace him, his personal physician, Rear Admiral Dr. Ronnie Jackson.
sentences.zh: 而是他提名谁来接替他：他的私人医师、海军少将罗尼·杰克逊博士。

sentences.en: The president just said, nope, I want Ronnie Jackson, my doctor.
sentences.zh: 总统直接说，不，我要罗尼·杰克逊，我的医生。

sentences.en: A Navy Rear Admiral, he has a surprise choice to lead the government's second largest department.
sentences.zh: 作为一名海军少将，他是领导政府第二大部门的意外人选。

sentences.en: He has served as White House physician over the past three administrations.
sentences.zh: 他在过去三届政府中一直担任白宫医生。

sentences.en: Recently, Jackson has been criticized by some after giving a glowing report on the president's health.
sentences.zh: 最近，杰克逊在对总统的健康状况给出了一份极力夸赞的报告后，受到了一些人的批评。

sentences.en: Here was a guy who had stood up on television and really defended him and gave him a positive rave review.
sentences.zh: 这家伙曾站在电视机前极力为他辩护，并给出了高度狂热的好评。

sentences.en: It's some people have, you know, just great genes.
sentences.zh: 有些人就是，你知道的，基因太好了。

sentences.en: You know, I told the president that if he had a healthier diet over the last 20 years, he might live to be 200 years old.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我告诉过总统，如果他过去20年保持更健康的饮食，他可能会活到200岁。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, he has incredible genes, I just assume.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想他拥有不可思议的基因。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, if I didn't watch what I ate, I wouldn't have the cardiac and overall health that he has.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道的，如果我不注意饮食，我就不会拥有他那样的心脏和整体健康状况。

sentences.en: So that's it, guys.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样，伙计们。

sentences.en: That's all the questions I've taken.
sentences.zh: 这就是我回答的所有问题。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们的时间。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: That's how he came to be the nominee for the Veterans Department.
sentences.zh: 这就是他成为退伍军人事务部被提名人的经过。

sentences.en: OK, so despite the fact that he doesn't have a ton of experience,
sentences.zh: 好的，尽管他没有丰富的经验，

sentences.en: Dr. Jackson is nominated for this job and is preparing for this hearing that's supposed to be on Wednesday morning before the Senate committee that will judge whether he can take this job.
sentences.zh: 杰克逊博士还是被提名担任此职，并正为周三上午在参议院委员会举行的听证会做准备，该委员会将评估他是否能胜任这份工作。

sentences.en: And my understanding is that generally the Senate defers to the president when it comes to nominations like this.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，在涉及此类提名时，参议院通常会顺从总统。

sentences.en: So isn't the assumption that this will occur and that he will probably get the job?
sentences.zh: 所以难道大家的假设不是这将会顺利通过，而且他很可能会得到这份工作吗？

sentences.en: I think at the start of this week, most people were betting that despite the concerns over his lack of qualifications, that the Senate would likely defer,
sentences.zh: 我认为在本周刚开始时，大多数人都押注，尽管人们对他的资历不足表示担忧，但参议院很可能会顺从，

sentences.en: that there would be a series of tough questions.
sentences.zh: 虽然会有一系列严厉的质问。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, there is that kind of deference where the Senate says, look,
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，还是存在那种顺从，即参议院会表示，听着，

sentences.en: the president has a right to put the people that he wants in charge of a department like this.
sentences.zh: 总统有权将他想要的人安排在这样一个部门担任负责人。

sentences.en: And if this is the guy he wants, then we're going to give it to him.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是他想要的人，那我们就把这个人交给他。

sentences.en: So what changed?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么改变了呢？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: what changed was a series of whistleblowers that came to members of Congress to make a series of allegations about Dr. Jackson that really didn't have much to do with this question of professional experience and management of a big department,
sentences.zh: 改变的原因是一系列举报人来到国会议员面前，对杰克逊博士提出了一系列指控，这些指控其实与专业经验和大部门管理的问题关系不大，

sentences.en: but rather had to do with his actions as the White House physician.
sentences.zh: 而更多地与他在担任白宫医师期间的行为有关。

sentences.en: And they generally broke down into three areas.
sentences.zh: 这些指控大致分为三个方面。

sentences.en: Allegations that he fostered a hostile work environment as the head of the White House Medical Office.
sentences.zh: 指控他在担任白宫医疗办公室主任期间营造了充满敌意的工作环境。

sentences.en: The second was that he was seen drinking and or drunk at times that would have been inappropriate for that to be the case.
sentences.zh: 第二是有人看到他在本不应该喝酒的场合饮酒或处于醉酒状态。

sentences.en: And then third was that he had been involved in inappropriately dispensing prescription medications to members of the White House staff for whom he was the doctor,
sentences.zh: 第三是他曾参与向其担任医生的白宫工作人员违规分发处方药，

sentences.en: that he was too loose in prescribing those medications.
sentences.zh: 他在开这些药物时过于随意。

sentences.en: Those are serious allegations.
sentences.zh: 这些都是严重的指控。

sentences.en: They are.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And what really triggered the reporting was when, on a bipartisan basis,
sentences.zh: 真正引发报道的是，两党一致决定，

sentences.en: the leadership of the committee that was to hold the hearings announced that the hearings would be delayed indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 负责举行听证会的委员会领导层宣布听证会将无限期推迟。

sentences.en: And, of course, when something like that happens, they have to give an explanation.
sentences.zh: 当然，当发生这种事情时，他们必须给出一个解释。

sentences.en: Why suddenly would this hearing be put off?
sentences.zh: 为什么这个听证会会突然被搁置？

sentences.en: And the reasons given were the ones that I just described, the sort of allegations that had been brought forward by whistleblowers.
sentences.zh: 给出的理由就是我刚才描述的那些，也就是举报人提出的各种指控。

sentences.en: And that's kind of where we were Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这就是周二下午我们所处的情况。

sentences.en: So how has President Trump responded, especially given what you've described as a strong relationship with Dr. Jackson?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普总统作何回应？特别是考虑到你所描述的他与杰克逊博士之间的密切关系？

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Tuesday afternoon, the president was asked about all of these swirling controversies.
sentences.zh: 周二下午，总统被问及所有这些铺天盖地的争议。

sentences.en: It was at the White House.
sentences.zh: 地点在白宫。

sentences.en: It's in the East Room.
sentences.zh: 就在东厅。

sentences.en: Melania and I are truly honored to welcome French President Macron, Mrs. Macron, to the White House.
sentences.zh: 梅拉尼娅和我非常荣幸地欢迎法国总统马克龙先生、马克龙夫人来到白宫。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Emmanuel Macron, the president of France, is in the United States for a series of meetings with the president.
sentences.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙正在美国与总统进行一系列会晤。

sentences.en: And as part of that, the two leaders held a press conference and a bunch of topics asked about foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，两位领导人举行了新闻发布会，并被问及了一堆有关外交政策的话题。

sentences.en: And then one of the American reporters asked the president.
sentences.zh: 随后，一名美国记者向总统提问。

sentences.en: Your nominee to run the Veterans Affairs Administration, Dr. Ronnie Jackson,
sentences.zh: 你提名的退伍军人事务管理局负责人选罗尼·杰克逊博士，

sentences.en: has run into some serious political headwinds on Capitol Hill with some serious allegations being leveled at him.
sentences.zh: 在国会山遭遇了一些严重的政治逆风，并被指控了一些严重的问题。

sentences.en: What about Dr. Jackson and all of these issues swirling around him?
sentences.zh: 关于杰克逊博士以及围绕着他的所有这些问题，你怎么看？

sentences.en: And I think we'd all expected to have a real forceful expression of support by the president for Dr. Jackson.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都预料到总统会对杰克逊博士表达强有力、坚决的支持。

sentences.en: And in some ways he did.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上他确实这么做了。

sentences.en: He said...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: But I will tell you, he's one of the finest people that I have met.
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，他是我见过的最优秀的人之一。

sentences.en: One of the finest men I've ever known.
sentences.zh: 我所知道的最优秀的男人之一。

sentences.en: Also, he's been the doctor for President Obama, I believe for President Bush.
sentences.zh: 此外，他曾是奥巴马总统的医生，我想也是布什总统的医生。

sentences.en: But then he sort of did something that surprised all of us, which is to sort of say that...
sentences.zh: 但随后他做了一件让我们所有人都感到惊讶的事情，那就是说……

sentences.en: We'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: I don't want to put a man through who's not a political person.
sentences.zh: 我不想让一个并非政界人士的人经历这一切。

sentences.en: I don't want to put a man through a process like this.
sentences.zh: 我不想让一个人经历这样的过程。

sentences.en: It's too ugly and too disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这太丑陋、太令人作呕了。

sentences.en: You know, if he were Dr. Jackson, he might just hang it up and not accept all of this abuse and drop out of contention.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果他是杰克逊博士，他可能就会直接挂冠而去，不接受所有这些辱骂，并退出竞选。

sentences.en: He said he had talked to Dr. Jackson on the phone and told him that, that it was up to him and that if he wanted to continue to fight this thing through,
sentences.zh: 他说他已经在电话里和杰克逊博士谈过了，告诉他这一切全凭他自己决定，如果他想继续把这件事斗争到底，

sentences.en: that President Trump would support him in that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统会在背后支持他。

sentences.en: But he repeatedly said...
sentences.zh: 但他反复说道……

sentences.en: But the fact is, I wouldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，我不会这么做。

sentences.en: If I was him, I don't think I would do it.
sentences.zh: 如果我是他，我想我不会这么做。

sentences.en: I wouldn't take this abuse.
sentences.zh: 我不会承受这种虐待。

sentences.en: To be abused by a bunch of politicians that aren't thinking nicely about our country, I really don't think personally he should do it.
sentences.zh: 被一群对我们国家没有好意的政客虐待，我真的不认为他个人应该这么做。

sentences.en: But it's totally his.
sentences.zh: 但这全凭他自己。

sentences.en: I would stand behind him.
sentences.zh: 我会支持他。

sentences.en: Totally his decision.
sentences.zh: 完全由他自己决定。

sentences.en: By the end of the press conference, it was sort of left unclear whether the president seemed to be hinting or suggesting that maybe this is what he thought should happen.
sentences.zh: 到新闻发布会结束时，人们仍然不清楚总统是否在暗示或建议这或许就是他认为应该发生的事情。

sentences.en: But White House officials said later, look, you just should take the president on face value, that he said it's up to Dr. Jackson whether to march forward.
sentences.zh: 但白宫官员后来表示，听着，你们只需按字面意思理解总统的话即可，他说过是否继续前进完全取决于杰克逊博士。

sentences.en: And that's what he meant.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的意思。

sentences.en: I mentioned at the top of the show there is some new breaking news tonight about the president's nominee to lead the VA, White House physician Ronnie Jackson.
sentences.zh: 我在节目开头提到过，今晚有一些关于总统提名的退伍军人事务部负责人、白宫医生罗尼·杰克逊的最新突发新闻。

sentences.en: The president is picked to run the Department of Veterans Affairs.
sentences.zh: 总统挑选来掌管退伍军人事务部的人。

sentences.en: Rear Admiral Ronnie Jackson is in trouble.
sentences.zh: 海军少将罗尼·杰克逊遇到麻烦了。

sentences.en: Senator John Tester is leading a push to try to look into the conduct of Admiral Jackson while he was at the White House, serving as the White House physician.
sentences.zh: 参议员乔恩·泰斯特正在带头试图调查杰克逊少将在白宫担任白宫医师期间的行为。

sentences.en: And late today, the ranking Democrat in the Veteran Affairs Committee, John Tester of Montana, addressed the allegations on NPR.
sentences.zh: 今天晚些时候，退伍军人事务委员会中职位最高的民主党人、来自蒙大拿州的乔恩·泰斯特在NPR上谈到了这些指控。

sentences.en: By Tuesday evening, at the sort of height of the controversy, we got more details.
sentences.zh: 到周二晚上，在争议达到某种高潮时，我们获得了更多细节。

sentences.en: Do you know what drugs were dispensed?
sentences.zh: 你知道分发的是什么药吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can't tell you exactly the name because I'm not a pharmaciSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不能准确说出名字，因为我不是药剂师。

sentences.en: Senator John Tester, who is a Democrat from Montana and the top Democrat on the committee that is taking a look at whether or not to confirm Dr. Jackson for the position,
sentences.zh: 参议员乔恩·泰斯特是来自蒙大拿州的民主党人，也是负责审查是否确认杰克逊博士任职资格的委员会中的最高民主党人，

sentences.en: went on the record Tuesday evening and really gave us some pretty amazing details in all three areas.
sentences.zh: 他在周二晚间公开表态，并真正向我们透露了在所有三个方面的一些相当惊人的细节。

sentences.en: 20-some people who got a hold of us and said, we've got a problem, this doctor has a problem.
sentences.zh: 二十多个人联系到我们并表示，我们有麻烦了，这个医生有问题。

sentences.en: There was a report done in 2012 that was a review of the medical office at the White House, of which Dr. Jackson was a part.
sentences.zh: 2012年曾做过一份报告，是对白宫医疗办公室的审查，杰克逊博士当时是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And the review that was done by the Navy Inspector General's office concluded that there had been terrible morale,
sentences.zh: 海军总监察长办公室进行的审查得出结论认为，那里的士气极差，

sentences.en: that Dr. Jackson had essentially been in a battle for control of the office with the other top official there, and that...
sentences.zh: 杰克逊博士基本上在与该办公室的其他高官争夺控制权，并且……

sentences.en: We were told time and time again, the people above him, he treated like gold.
sentences.zh: 我们一次又一次地被告知，对于他上级的人，他视若珍宝。

sentences.en: The people below him, he belittled, screamed at them.
sentences.zh: 对于他下属的人，他贬低他们，冲他们尖叫。

sentences.en: Subordinates in the office felt like they were trapped in the middle of this battle.
sentences.zh: 办公室里的下属觉得他们被夹这场争斗的夹心饼干中动弹不得。

sentences.en: Where the people that worked around him felt like they had to walk on eggshells.
sentences.zh: 那些在他身边工作的人觉得他们不得不小心翼翼、如履薄冰。

sentences.en: And then in the area of accusations of being drunk, Senator Tester said that there had been multiple allegations that he appeared at the White House drunk,
sentences.zh: 接着在被指控醉酒的方面，泰斯特参议员表示，有多项指控称他曾酒气冲天地出现在白宫，

sentences.en: and that on one occasion on a White House trip, this is during President Obama's administration,
sentences.zh: 并且在白宫的一次出访期间（这是在奥巴马总统执政期间），

sentences.en: that when officials went to find Dr. Jackson because somebody needed medical treatment,
sentences.zh: 当官员们因为有人需要医疗护理而去找杰克逊博士时，

sentences.en: that they went to his hotel room and found him inebriated, passed out, and could not revive him to the point that they had to take his medical equipment
sentences.zh: 他们去他的酒店房间发现他烂醉如泥、不省人事，根本无法叫醒他，以至于他们不得不拿走他的医疗设备，

sentences.en: and bring the equipment to another doctor so that that other doctor could help the patient.
sentences.zh: 把设备带给另一位医生，以便那位医生能够帮助病人。

sentences.en: That seems like the ultimate dereliction of duty in terms of what's expected of the White House physician.
sentences.zh: 就对白宫医生的期望而言，这似乎是终极的失职。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And in fact, I think the remarkable details of that story is what underscores and helps to explain why the senators took these allegations so seriously, right?
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为这个故事中引人注目的细节凸显并有助于解释为什么参议员们会如此严肃地对待这些指控，对吧？

sentences.en: Earlier in the week, when the allegations were more vague, it was a little harder to understand why this had become such an issue so quickly.
sentences.zh: 在本周早些时候，当这些指控还比较模糊时，人们有点难以理解为什么这件事会如此迅速地成为一个大问题。

sentences.en: I think when you hear those details about the chief White House doctor kind of unable to do his duties when called upon
sentences.zh: 我想当你听到这些关于白宫首席医生在接到召唤时却无法履行职责的细节时——

sentences.en: for reasons of being so drunk that they couldn't rouse him, assuming that that's true, those are just allegations, but that's why everybody was taking this so seriously.
sentences.zh: 原因是他醉得不省人事、怎么也叫不醒（假设这是真的，这些目前只是指控），这就是为什么每个人都如此严肃对待此事的原因。

sentences.en: If you're drunk and something happens with the president, it's very difficult to go in and treat the president how it needs to be done.
sentences.zh: 如果你喝醉了，而总统那里出了什么事，那就很难进去以应有的方式治疗总统。

sentences.en: So this is totally unacceptable under this environment.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种环境下，这是完全不可接受的。

sentences.en: And Mike, what about this third area of concern, Dr. Jackson's distribution of prescription drugs?
sentences.zh: 迈克，关于第三个令人担忧的领域，也就是杰克逊医生分发处方药这件事，你怎么看？

sentences.en: The word is, is that on overseas trips in particular, that the admiral would go down the aisle way of the airplane and say, all right, who wants to go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 据传闻，特别是在海外行程中，这位海军少将会在飞机的过道走来走去，说，好了，谁想睡觉？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the concern there, according to Senator Tester, is specifically that Dr. Jackson and other members of his medical staff
sentences.zh: 因此，根据泰斯特参议员的说法，人们的具体担忧在于，杰克逊医生和他的医疗团队的其他成员

sentences.en: would routinely distribute a couple of different drugs to White House staff, members of the press and others on Air Force One on long trips.
sentences.zh: 会在空军一号的长途飞行中，例行公事般地向白宫员工、媒体成员和其他人分发几种不同的药物。

sentences.en: Like an Ambien type.
sentences.zh: 类似于安必恩那种。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: And what he would distribute would be Ambien, which is a sleeping aid.
sentences.zh: 他分发的药物其实就是安必恩，这是一种安眠药。

sentences.en: A lot of these trips are 10, 12, 14 hours long.
sentences.zh: 其中很多行程长达10、12、14个小时。

sentences.en: So he would distribute Ambien for people to help them sleep on the long flights.
sentences.zh: 所以他会分发安必恩，好让大家在漫长的飞行中入睡。

sentences.en: And then he would distribute a prescription drug called Provigil, which promotes wakefulness.
sentences.zh: 然后他还会分发一种名为莫达非尼的处方药，这种药能提神醒脑。

sentences.en: So when they landed, the White House officials would get this drug to help them stay awake and essentially get on the correct time for the country that they were landing in.
sentences.zh: 因此当他们着陆时，白宫官员会服用这种药来保持清醒，并基本上适应他们降落国家的正确时区。

sentences.en: And those are drugs that if regular people wanted to get them, they'd have to go to a doctor.
sentences.zh: 这些药如果是普通人想要获取，就必须去看医生。

sentences.en: They'd get a prescription.
sentences.zh: 拿到处方。

sentences.en: They'd take the prescription to a pharmacy and have that filled in the sort of standard way.
sentences.zh: 然后把处方带到药房，以标准的方式去配药。

sentences.en: Dr. Jackson, Senator Tester said, was simply had little packages of them and would hand them out to people who said they wanted them.
sentences.zh: 泰斯特参议员说，杰克逊医生则是简单地备好一小包一小包的药，直接发给那些说想要的人。

sentences.en: So he would actually just go down the aisle and sort of say who wants to.
sentences.zh: 所以他其实就是沿着过道走，问谁想要。

sentences.en: Sounds like whoever wanted them.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像是谁想要就给谁。

sentences.en: Whoever wanted them.
sentences.zh: 谁想要就给谁。

sentences.en: Now, to be fair to Dr. Jackson, it is quite true that he was not the first White House doctor to do this.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，为了对杰克逊医生公平起见，他确实不是第一个这样做的白宫医生。

sentences.en: This is a practice that has been done by prior White House doctors going back many years.
sentences.zh: 多年前历任的白宫医生就一直在这样做。

sentences.en: It's also a practice on State Department flights, Defense Department flights that take, you know, many, many hours.
sentences.zh: 这也是国务院航班、国防部航班上的惯例，那些航班你知道的，要飞好几个小时。

sentences.en: But, you know, again, for members of the Senate who were considering whether or not to put Dr. Jackson in charge of, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，对于那些正在考虑是否要让杰克逊医生来领导，你知道的，

sentences.en: not only one of the largest bureaucracies, but also the largest health care system in the country,
sentences.zh: 不仅是最大的官僚机构之一，也是全国最大的医疗体系的参议员们来说，

sentences.en: the VA health care system, which, you know, manages the medical care of the nation's veterans.
sentences.zh: 也就是退伍军人事务部医疗系统，它负责管理全国退伍军人的医疗护理。

sentences.en: You know, to the senators, this question of whether or not he was willing to be distributing these drugs without a prescription was very concerning to them.
sentences.zh: 参议员们对于他是否愿意在没有处方的情况下分发这些药物，感到非常担忧。

sentences.en: I do want to flag one thing.
sentences.zh: 我确实想指出一件事。

sentences.en: It sounds like Dr. Jackson's most egregious moment occurred under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 听起来杰克逊医生最过分的行为是发生在奥巴马总统任内。

sentences.en: And yet I have read that President Obama also spoke highly of the doctor and kept him on, obviously, through the end of his two terms as president.
sentences.zh: 然而我读到过，奥巴马总统对这位医生评价也很高，并且显然让他留任直到他两届总统任期结束。

sentences.en: And then he went on to serve President Trump.
sentences.zh: 后来他还继续为特朗普总统服务。

sentences.en: So I wonder if there's a kind of broader sense of affinity for this doctor that has allowed him to stay in this job, despite what we're now hearing.
sentences.zh: 所以我在想，人们对这位医生是不是有一种更广泛的认可，才让他得以保住这份工作，尽管我们现在听到了这些消息。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's actually one of the most confusing and intriguing aspects of all of this.
sentences.zh: 这其实是所有这些事情中最让人困惑、最耐人寻味的方面之一。

sentences.en: I talked to a number of former Obama administration officials, especially after the details emerged that Senator Tester had offered,
sentences.zh: 我跟好几位前奥巴马政府官员聊过，特别是在泰斯特参议员披露的细节浮出水面之后，

sentences.en: and none of them said that they recognized any of this behavior.
sentences.zh: 但他们中没有人说自己见过这种行为。

sentences.en: President Obama in 2015 and 2016 gave glowing reviews to Dr. Jackson about his performance at the White House as the chief doctor,
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统在2015年和2016年对杰克逊医生在白宫担任首席医生的表现给予了高度评价，

sentences.en: even recommending Dr. Jackson for a promotion to Admiral.
sentences.zh: 甚至还推荐杰克逊医生晋升为海军少将。

sentences.en: And so it's very hard to square those two things, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，要把这两件事结合起来看很难理出头绪。

sentences.en: Well, what do we know about the whistleblowers who are making these really serious claims?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于那些爆出这些极其严重的指控的吹哨人，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: Do we know anything about who they are?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们是谁吗？

sentences.en: Not much.
sentences.zh: 不多。

sentences.en: I mean, look, that's the definition of a whistleblower is that they come forward anonymously to, and in this case to members of Congress, to offer information and concerns.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，这就是吹哨人的定义，他们匿名站出来，在这个案例中是向国会议员提供信息和担忧。

sentences.en: And so at the moment, what we have really is the information directly from the lawmakers in both parties, mind you,
sentences.zh: 所以目前，我们真正掌握的信息直接来自于两党的议员——提醒一下，两党都有——

sentences.en: and their staffs describing what the whistleblowers have brought forward.
sentences.zh: 还有他们的幕僚，他们描述了吹哨人所提供的情况。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: You know, listening to you talk, I'm struck that in some way these particular allegations are more alarming
sentences.zh: 你知道，听你这么说，我深感震惊：在某种程度上，当把这个人视为总统的医生时，这些具体的指控要比把他视为退伍军人事务部负责人时更加令人担忧。

sentences.en: when considering this person as the president's doctor than when considering him as the head of the Veterans Affairs Department.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某种意义上说确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that's true in a sense.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，退伍军人事务部负责人同时也是这个大型医院系统的负责人这一事实，

sentences.en: I do think that the fact that the head of the VA also is the head of this big hospital system,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些具体的担忧与他将要胜任的工作之间确实存在某种联系。

sentences.en: I do think there's some nexus there between these particular concerns and the kind of job he would do.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我的意思是，即使明天关于他是否应该成为领导退伍军人的被提名人的问题

sentences.en: But sure, I mean, even if tomorrow the question of whether or not he should be the nominee to lead the VA,
sentences.zh: 明天就被搁置了，我的意思是，我认为仍然会有很多挥之不去的担忧，

sentences.en: if that were taken off the table tomorrow, I mean, I still think there would be a lot of lingering concern about,
sentences.zh: 比如，他到底是不是照顾总统健康的正合适人选？

sentences.en: well, is he the right person to be attending to the president's health?
sentences.zh: 这肯定不是特朗普总统希望看到的情况，他本以为通过这样做能启动这项任命。

sentences.en: That's certainly not what President Trump would have liked to think that he set in motion by doing this.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道他有什么办法能避开这一点。

sentences.en: But I don't know that there's going to be a way for him to avoid it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再说一次，你可以想象一下，提名程序的政治进程可能会走到尽头，

sentences.en: I mean, again, you know, you could imagine the political process of the nomination coming to a close,
sentences.zh: 但对于杰克逊医生是否还能继续在海军担任那个职务，现在仍然笼罩着一层阴影。

sentences.en: and there's still being a cloud now over Dr. Jackson about whether he can continue in that job in the Navy.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，通过提名他最喜欢的医生、他的白宫私人医生担任退伍军人事务部部长，

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying that by nominating his favorite doctor, his White House physician, to be the head of the VA,
sentences.zh: 总统可能在无意中取消了这位医生继续担任白宫医生的资格。

sentences.en: the president may have unintentionally disqualified that doctor from continuing in his role as a White House physician.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这最终可能是个结果。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that might be the result in the end.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 不客气，我很乐意。

sentences.en: Sure, happy to do it.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，周二针对杰克逊医生的指控愈演愈烈，白宫开始更加积极地为这位医生辩护。

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that as allegations against Dr. Jackson intensified on Tuesday, the White House became more aggressive in its defense of the doctor.
sentences.zh: 总统和杰克逊医生于周二晚上进行了面对面会晤，白宫随后发表声明，称这位医生的履历“无可挑剔”，

sentences.en: The president and Dr. Jackson met face-to-face on Tuesday evening, and the White House released a statement calling the doctor's record, quote, impeccable,
sentences.zh: 并表示他不会被虚假指控所陷害。

sentences.en: and saying he would not be railroaded by false accusations.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的舞台上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 JD·

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 NYTimes.com 上直播部分精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收听。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，就在埃里克·迈纳西亚周一驾驶货车在多伦多撞死10名行人前不久，

sentences.en: The Times reports that moments before he used a van to kill 10 pedestrians in Toronto on Monday,
sentences.zh: 他在 Facebook 上发布了一条充满对女性敌意的信息。

sentences.en: Alec Manassian posted a hostile message toward women on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 在这条信息中，迈纳西亚赞扬了埃利奥特·罗杰。罗杰曾在2014年发布了一段视频，描述了他对拒绝他的女性的愤怒，随后实施了一起大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: In the message, Manassian praised Elliot Rodger, who in 2014 carried out a mass shooting after posting a video describing his own rage toward women for rejecting him.
sentences.zh: 迈纳西亚写道：“向至尊绅士埃利奥特·罗杰致敬。”

sentences.en: All hail Supreme Gentleman Elliot Rodger, Manassian wrote.
sentences.zh: 同学说，迈纳西亚表现出极端的社交尴尬，曾经说过：“我害怕女孩。”

sentences.en: Classmates said Manassian displayed extreme social awkwardness and had once said, quote, I am afraid of girls.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个被严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 在由我和萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期 Metro 中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·凯尼格为您讲述，一些试图维持影响力却在不知不觉中失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我看看。
